name: OpenDIAG

download_steps.title: Hold the button
download_steps.text: Press and hold the button on the OpenDiag device — keep holding it through the next step.

download_steps.title: Plug in the USB cable
download_steps.text: While still holding the button, connect OpenDiag to your computer's USB port. Release the button once it's plugged in.

finish_note: When the update finishes, unplug OpenDiag and plug it back in normally.
